protocol: Fixed samples and annotations before extraction changes; development-only failure inspection, then freeze parser hash before measuring held-out results. No model training. Both versions use identical cached RustO spans. Invoice jobs use preset comma decimals in both versions, including one development invoice printed with decimal dots; this mismatch remains an error, not automatic locale inference.

sroie.license_note: Repository MIT applies to software; SROIE dataset terms remain separate. Research subset kept local, not redistributed.
sroie.selection: 40 IDs with smallest SHA256(rs-ocr-financial-v1:<three-digit id>) over 0..625; grouped by exact company, greedy balanced dev/test.

zenodo.selection: 12 annotation names with smallest SHA256(rs-ocr-financial-v1:<stem>); first six dev, next six test.

commons.selection: Eight purposive readable public-domain historical/modern scans, one blank cheque as negative control. Small diagnostic set, not representative of modern banking.
